endorsements.quote: Regulatory requirements add a further gate: population-level research and planning applications sit outside medical device regulation, but the Phase 3 point-of-care uses in Table 2 would likely qualify as software as a medical device, requiring conformity assessment before deployment.
Governance frameworks for LLM-derived data, including audit mechanisms detecting differential extraction accuracy across demographics, must be established before clinical deployment ( 33 , 37 ).

Each layer implies distinct evaluation targets: for Layer 1, linkage sensitivity and specificity against gold-standard identifiers; for Layer 2, entity-level precision, recall, and F1 against expert annotation; for Layer 3, relationship-level inter-annotator agreement and the two-target validation strategy set out below.
These risks are manageable - requiring models to cite specific text spans as evidence, version-controlling prompts alongside models, and tracking model version provenance - but not eliminable.
Multi-site validation studies assessing extraction accuracy across UEC documentation types, stratified by patient demographics, are needed before population-level deployment ( 11 ).

unlisted_practices: Restrict AI-inferred absence-of-care extractions to population-level aggregate analysis rather than individual-level determinations until validated.
Tune LLM extraction of inferred absences to favour precision over recall and attach provenance and confidence metadata to each extraction.
Use constrained generation that anchors each LLM-extracted relationship to a quoted source text span to make extractions auditable.
Prefer the least powerful model capable of the required accuracy for clinical text extraction.
Design extraction schemas that distinguish clinical observations from subjective interpretations to avoid automating documentation bias such as stigmatising language.
Involve patients and affected communities in shaping which questions are asked of AI-derived clinical data graphs.
Develop shared annotation schemes for urgent and emergency care-specific relationship types.
Require higher validation thresholds for individual-level clinical applications of AI extraction than for population-level research uses.
Use local model deployment for LLM processing of clinical narratives.

screen.reason: This is a Perspective paper proposing a three-layer knowledge graph and NLP architecture for urgent and emergency care and outlining its validation, governance, and infrastructure requirements.
